text.title: Competitor Analysis Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable input signals onto a conclusion that references a rule id from 01-core-rules.xml.

conclusion.verdict: halt; broaden category or run idea-generation first
STOP and pin geography before any snapshot
skip price columns; emit 'enterprise quote' annotation
drop or source every future competitor before snapshots

branch.when: pricing == visible AND future_competitors_without_signal == 0 AND gap_analysis_done == true AND positioning_statement == missing

conclusion.verdict: write the template-form statement before finalising the gap analysis

branch.when: pricing == visible AND future_competitors_without_signal == 0 AND NOT (gap_analysis_done == true AND positioning_statement == missing)

conclusion.verdict: run full 5-step framework with fan-out snapshots

example.trace: direct=6 -> geography=pinned -> pricing=visible -> run full framework, fan-out 12 snapshots.
